span.p:
All five extend ControllerBase, require a signed-in user and
query ApplicationDbContext directly (no service layer).
Optional parameters default to null. Access rules:
DocumentsController: Upload, Create any role; UpdateDocumentStatus,
ArchiveDocument Admin or Consultant; case ownership is checked.
AdminController: Admin only. DeleteUser is a soft delete
(IsActive = false, the same state as SuspendUser).
StatsController: GetAdminStats Admin; GetConsultantStats
Admin or Consultant; GetClientStats any role.
